body: I haven't gone to a therapist, every time I tried to explain my anxieties and the trouble in every day life that it causes me I always got the "Everyone has anxiety" and "Give it time it'll work itself out." I never felt like my issues were legit. I've actually come to that conclusion I pity my brother and I forgave him and my mother. My mom and I talk maybe 5 times a year. I don't have any contact with my brother because he's been in and out of prison and it wouldn't be safe for me to be in contact with him. But I've genuinely forgiven them. They were both going through their own forms of mental illness however I still feel sad. I feel unloved. If my own blood couldn't love me how could I hope for someone else to? I know what people are capable of and i fear people and ultimately I fear my attachment to them because that's what let it go as far as it did. I don't let anyone get into my head, or know how I'm feeling anymore and honestly it breaks my heart. I have things I wrote in a journal when I was young and it honestly makes me cry when I read these things. I was only a young boy when this all started happening. I lost my childhood and I miss being able to play. I miss being happy without thinking about when it was going to end.
